plugins.name: pmcro-capture
plugins.description: Turn a captured demonstration (screenshots or photos plus notes) into a draft skill, with private metadata stripped and a human review gate.

plugins.name: pmcro-cloudflare
plugins.description: PMCR-O website and landing-page setup on Cloudflare, with affiliate-disclosure checks, trail frames for each step, and deploys gated behind human approval.

plugins.name: pmcro-content
plugins.description: PMCR-O content creation: scripts in the founder's own voice with sourced claims, and guardrails for synthetic voice and image.

plugins.name: pmcro-core
plugins.description: PMCR-O role skills (Orchestrator, Planner, Maker, Checker, Reflector) and the Trail Player for recording direction with disclosure tiers.

plugins.name: pmcro-csuite
plugins.description: PMCR-O C-Suite domain skills (CEO, CFO, COO, CTO, CMO, CRO, CHRO, CLO, Chief of Staff), imported from the PMCR-O-Marketplace colony repo.

plugins.name: pmcro-dotnet
plugins.description: PMCR-O .NET and Microsoft Agent Framework skills, built so small local models can use them through progressive disclosure.

plugins.name: pmcro-figma
plugins.description: Template-driven Figma plugins: render a template into code.ts and ui.html, lint it against Figma's authoring rules, then hand the files to Figma's own MCP.

plugins.name: pmcro-mcpserver
plugins.description: Generate the company's MCP servers: a read-only server that serves every plugin's skills with progressive disclosure, plus a .NET server generator in the owner's pattern.

plugins.name: pmcro-memory
plugins.description: Shared, tiered, append-only memory for the founder and every agent: the company's knowledge, searchable, with provenance and human-owned acceptance.

plugins.name: pmcro-social
plugins.description: PMCR-O account operations: a credential-free registry of the founder's accounts, a weekly brief of what needs a human, and rules for drafting and approving posts.

plugins.name: pmcro-training
plugins.description: Validate and gate PMCR-O fine-tuning datasets (SFT JSONL) against the owner's working schema before any training run.
